name: homelab
description: Homelab ops for Unraid, UniFi Network, and Home Assistant: MCP servers for all three plus skills for Unraid control (including web-UI-hang diagnosis), macOS-on-KVM VM gotchas, and homelab networking (Tailscale split DNS/subnet routing, step-ca cert renewal).

interface.shortDescription: MCP servers + runbooks for Unraid, UniFi Network, and Home Assistant.
interface.longDescription: Operational tooling for a self-hosted homelab. Bundles three MCP servers — UniFi Network, Home Assistant (via mcp-proxy), and Unraid (read-only by default) — with every endpoint and credential supplied through environment variables (nothing committed). Adds three skills: unraid-control (MCP-vs-CLI surface detection, a read-only/safe-write/destructive safety model, an approval + confirm-token flow, and web-UI-hang / D-state I/O-saturation diagnosis); homelab-macos-vms (running macOS guests on KVM without GPU passthrough — virtio-net placement, vmvga-vs-qxl, auto-login/recovery, and screen-sharing gotchas); and homelab-networking (Tailscale split-DNS and subnet routing, step-ca mutual-TLS cert renewal, and Apple trust caveats).
capabilities: MCP servers for UniFi Network, Home Assistant, and Unraid — all env-var-driven, no committed secrets
Unraid control with a read-only/safe-write/destructive safety model and web-UI-hang diagnosis
macOS-on-KVM VM operations and homelab networking (Tailscale, step-ca TLS) runbooks
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the Unraid array status and any degraded disks.
